title: Virgo: your love

summary: Love feels like homework, and then it gets interesting. What is happening for a Virgo Moon in love between now and late January.

inside: Why love feels like hard work at the moment
What changes on December 5, December 10 and January 24
What to do if you are with someone, and if you are not
intro: If you are a Virgo by Moon sign, love has probably felt like homework lately: serious conversations, slow progress, and the sense that you are being tested. You are not imagining it, and it is not a sign that something is wrong with you or with your person.

The good news is that three things shift in the next two months. A stuck situation starts to move, a spark of fresh romance arrives, and your friends become a real source of help. Here is each one, with its date.

sections.label: The weight
title: Why love feels
like homework.
paragraphs: The planet of patience and responsibility is sitting in your house of partners, and it takes love seriously. It is read as tests, delays and a lot of talking things through. Casual connections tend to fall away, and real ones are asked to become more honest and more committed.

It has also been moving backwards, which makes everything feel as if it is being gone over twice: the same conversation, the same doubt. The tradition’s view is steadying. What survives this influence is said to be built to last, because it has been checked properly.

sections.label: December 10
title: Things start
moving again.
paragraphs: On December 10 that planet stops moving backwards and turns forward. Decisions that have been hanging tend to get made in the following weeks: a relationship is defined, a date is set, or an honest ending finally happens. Either way, you stop waiting.
It stays in your house of partners well beyond these two months, so love remains a serious matter for you. The difference is that effort starts to produce results.

sections.label: December 5
title: A spark,
out of nowhere.
paragraphs: On December 5 the hungriest, most restless influence in the sky enters your house of romance, where it stays for about a year and a half. It is read as sudden crushes, fresh sparks and attraction to someone different from your usual type, perhaps from another background or a different world altogether.

It is exciting and it is meant to be. The one piece of advice the tradition gives is to go slowly: this influence loves beginnings and exaggerates feelings, so give anything new a few months before you decide what it is.

sections.label: January 24
title: Your friends
step in.
paragraphs: On January 24 the planet of luck moves into your house of friends and gains. It is read as more help, more people and more invitations. For love this matters in a simple way: introductions come through your circle, and friends give better advice than usual.

rows.note: In your house of luck. A good day for an honest, hopeful conversation.
Fresh romantic energy arrives, for a year and a half.
In your house of conversation. Say the thing you have been rehearsing.
A stuck situation with a partner starts to move.
Help and introductions come through your circle.

items.name: If you are in a relationship
items.text: Be patient with your person and with the pace. Have the practical conversations you have been avoiding: money, time, where this is going. After December 10 ask for a clear answer, and give one.

items.name: If something has been stuck
items.text: Wait until after December 10 before you conclude anything. Situations that looked finished often move again once the backward motion ends.

items.name: If you are single
items.text: From December 5 expect to be surprised by who catches your eye. Enjoy it, and go slowly. From late January, say yes to plans with friends, because that is where the good introductions are.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Virgo Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Virgo. Many people with a Virgo Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.
They are calculated from the planets’ real positions, in US Eastern time, and they are the same for everyone with this Moon sign. What they mean for you in detail depends on the rest of your chart.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
